subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Vioxx and Hidden Heart Risks
description: A quick, practical guide to Vioxx and Hidden Heart Risks.

hook.text: Merck's painkiller Vioxx was used by 80 million people. It doubled the risk of heart attacks.

buildup.text: Clinical trials showed cardiovascular risks early on. Merck downplayed the findings in its marketing.

discovery.text: An estimated 27,000 heart attacks may have been caused by Vioxx before its withdrawal in 2004.

twist.text: Internal emails showed scientists raised alarms. Marketing overruled safety. Profit won.

climax.text: Merck paid $4.85 billion in settlements. The drug that helped pain caused thousands of heart attacks.

punchline.text: Pain relief that caused heart attacks. Merck knew.

quiz.question: What was hidden about Vioxx?
options: It doubled heart attack risk, which Merck downplayed
